The '''Engebo system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Danjar sector/Legends|Danjar sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Engebo V]] and its primary star [[Engebo]].
